passages.text: Note 13 : Borrowings Short-Term Debt Short-term debt, which primarily includes the current portion of long-term debt, was $ 2.5 billion as of December 27, 2025 and $ 3.7 billion as of December 28, 2024. The current portion of long-term debt includes debt classified as short-term based on time remaining until maturity. We have an ongoing authorization from our Board of Directors to borrow up to $ 10.0 billion under our commercial paper program. We issued and repaid commercial paper of $ 3.5 billion in 2025 and $ 7.3 billion in 2024 and repaid $ 3.9 billion of commercial paper in 2023. As of December 27, 2025 and December 28, 2024, we had no commercial paper outstanding.

credit_strengths.text: Operating cash flow covers the dividend with room to spare, and the current ratio sits above both the prior year and the sector median, reflecting a liquid working-capital position supported by a large cash balance that cushions near-term obligations.

Net leverage on a cash-and-short-investment basis sits comfortably below the next risk-band boundary, and the indicative financial risk profile is Minimal, with the leverage tier and cash-flow tier both at the strongest level in the framework.

key_risks.text: Operating income is negative and the operating margin is below the sector median, so EBITDA coverage of interest trails the sector median despite improving sharply year over year; the interest coverage ratio on operating income remains negative and well below peers.

Capital expenditure exceeds operating cash flow, producing negative free cash flow and a negative free-cash-flow-to-debt ratio far below the sector median; the heavy fabrication investment program is the central cash-flow risk given the disclosed liquidity and capital resources discussion.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Gross leverage is roughly triple the sector median and net leverage on the same definition is above the sector median, though the maturity ladder is well spread with only a modest slice due in the next twelve months and the bulk beyond year five.

Cash flow to debt is below the sector median but improved year over year, and the commercial paper program is fully undrawn at year end, leaving the revolving short-term funding channel available as a liquidity backstop rather than a drawn reliance.

overall_credit_view.text: The indicative profile is Minimal on both leverage and cash-flow tiers, with headroom to the next boundary, but the strength rests on cash and short investments rather than on earnings, which remain negative at the operating line.

Our judgement is that debt service is manageable while the fabrication build-out is funded, but sustained negative free cash flow and below-median margins leave little cushion; a recovery in operating profitability, not further balance-sheet capacity, is the key swing factor.

credit_strengths.text: 經營現金流足以覆蓋股息且有餘裕，而流動比率高於去年及行業中位數，反映流動資金狀況穩健，並由龐大現金結餘支撐，可緩衝短期債務責任。
以現金及短期投資計算的淨槓桿比率穩居下一風險區間界線之下，而指示性財務風險狀況為極低，槓桿級別及現金流級別均處於框架內最強水平。

key_risks.text: 經營收入為負，經營利潤率低於行業中位數，因此儘管 EBITDA 對利息的覆蓋按年大幅改善，仍落後於行業中位數；以經營收入計算的利息覆蓋率仍為負值，且遠低於同業。
資本開支超過經營現金流，導致自由現金流為負，而自由現金流對債務比率為負且遠低於行業中位數；鑑於已披露的流動資金及資本資源討論，沉重的製造投資計劃是核心現金流風險。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 總槓桿比率約為行業中位數的三倍，按相同定義計算的淨槓桿比率亦高於行業中位數，惟到期結構分佈良好，未來十二個月內到期的部分僅佔少數，大部分在五年後到期。
現金流對債務比率低於行業中位數，但按年有所改善，而商業票據計劃於年末全數未提取，使循環短期融資渠道可作為流動資金後備，而非已提取的依賴。

overall_credit_view.text: 指示性狀況在槓桿及現金流級別均為極低，距下一界線仍有緩衝空間，但實力建基於現金及短期投資而非盈利，經營層面盈利仍然為負。
我們的判斷是，在製造擴建獲得融資期間，債務償付仍屬可控，但持續負自由現金流及低於中位數的利潤率留下的緩衝有限；經營盈利能力復甦而非進一步的資產負債表容量，才是關鍵的擺動因素。
